# Phase One — Theoretical File Map

This is a hypothesis map only. Actual files must be confirmed before rewriting.

## Likely source families

- `src/character/**`: identity, performance state, evaluation, serialization.
- `src/render/**` and `tools/render/**`: production geometry, preview/export bridge, frame rendering.
- `src/camera/**`: views, shot plans, framing, continuity.
- `src/persistence/**`: save, import, restoration, transient filtering.
- `src/scenes/**`: one-minute sitcom project, dialogue, text boxes, titles, timeline.
- `tools/verify/**`: feature smokes, browser proof, scale courts, metadata, compliance.
- `proofs/**`: source project, preview, final MP4, proof frames, manifests, hashes.
- `package.json`: only if verification or render command coverage is incomplete.

## Files that may be written

Only files proven defective or missing after full readback. Every changed file will be rewritten completely, kept below 120 JavaScript lines, tab-indented, fully documented, and verified against consumers.
